question.text: What will be the Powerball Advertised Jackpot on December 31, 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as the Powerball Advertised Jackpot for the next scheduled drawing, as of December 31, 2026.
question.fine_print: The source for this question will be [Powerball.com](https://www.powerball.com/). [TexasLottery](https://www.texaslottery.com/export/sites/lottery/Games/Powerball/Estimated_Jackpot.html) may be used as a backup source.

research:
I couldn't confirm whether anyone won the Oct 26 drawing. The two current official figures are $687M for Oct 26 and $716M projected for Oct 28 if no one won. Timing ambiguity: Dec 31, 2026 is a Thursday. If the snapshot is taken around 00:00 UTC on Dec 31 (Dec 30 evening ET), the "next drawing" is likely Wed Dec 30. If it is taken later on Dec 31, it is Sat Jan 2, 2027.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-10-27: Powerball.com shows an estimated jackpot of $687M (cash value $294.7M) for Mon Oct 26, with results still pending. It also says there was no jackpot or Match 5 winner in the previous drawing. [powerball.com](https://www.powerball.com/)
- 2026-10-27: Texas Lottery (the backup source) shows $687M for 10/26. If there is no winner, the estimate for the next drawing (Wed Oct 28) is $716M. [TexasLottery](https://www.texaslottery.com/export/sites/lottery/Games/Powerball/Estimated_Jackpot.html)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. About 28 drawings remain, from Oct 26 through Dec 30: Oct 26 and 28, 13 in November and 13 in December.
- 2026-10-27: Reports conflict on the Oct 26 numbers. A summary of usamega's results page listed 18-26-49-50-54, Powerball 1, 3x, with "$691 Million". My fetch of Powerball.com showed those same numbers as the Oct 24 draw. News reports say Oct 24 was 4-5-15-19-55, Powerball 19. I could not confirm whether the Oct 26 jackpot was won. [usamega](https://www.usamega.com/powerball/results), [Yahoo](https://www.yahoo.com/news/us/articles/did-anyone-win-powerball-winning-024538753.html)

## 3. Recent news
- 2026-10-26: The jackpot is $687M (cash $294.7M). It is the 32nd drawing of the run, which reset to $20M on Aug 15 after the Aug 12 jackpot won in Illinois ($1.04B final). [Daily Commercial](https://www.dailycommercial.com/story/news/2026/10/26/powerball-numbers-florida-winner-monday-october-halloween/92439209007/), [Powerball.com](https://www.powerball.com/powerball-jackpot-climbs-to-estimated-687-million-for-monday-night-drawing)
- 2026-10-24: No jackpot winner at $665-674M; sources disagree on the figure. [the-review](https://www.the-review.com/story/news/lottery/2026/10/25/did-anyone-win-powerball-last-night-see-oct-24-powerball-numbers/92429056007/)
- 2026-10-25: Forbes reports the jackpot "nears $700 million". [Forbes](https://forbes.com/sites/zacharyfolk/2026/10/25/powerball-jackpot-nears-700-million-but-a-winner-would-take-home-much-less-after-taxes)

## 4. Base rates (Texas Lottery advertised history)
- **Current run, Aug 15 to Oct 26, 2026:**
  - Starting from $20M: $35M, $48M, $68M, $81M, $96M, $119M (Aug 29), $146M (Sep 2), $207M (Sep 9), $251M (Sep 14), $298M (Sep 19), $360M (Sep 26), $409M (Sep 30), $467M (Oct 5), $516M (Oct 10), $562M (Oct 14), $607M (Oct 19), $687M (Oct 26).
  - Recent growth is about $13-40M per drawing and speeding up ($687M to $716M is +$29M).
  - Some advertised steps were small, e.g. $600M to $607M. [TexasLottery](https://www.texaslottery.com/export/sites/lottery/Games/Powerball/Estimated_Jackpot.html)
- **Path after a reset:** about $20M to $100-120M in roughly 6-8 drawings, about $200M in about 11, and about $300M in about 16.
  - Jan 2026 run: $20M (Dec 27, 2025), $209M by Jan 21 (17 drawings).
  - May 2026 run: $20M (May 2), $172M by May 30 (12 drawings).
- **If there is no winner through Dec 30:** growth at $30-100M+ per drawing would put the jackpot near or above $2B, the top of the question's range. For comparison, the Sep 6 to Dec 24, 2025 run reached a $1.82B final; advertised figures were $740M on Dec 1, $1.0B on Dec 13 and $1.70B on Dec 24.
- **How long runs last:**
  - 2026 so far: March 2 ($250.8M), five wins by May 2 ($20M split FL/TX), Aug 12 (May-Aug run of about 43 drawings).
  - The current run is at 32 drawings.
  - Runs that reach $1B+ have recently been won within about 5-10 more drawings: Sep 2025 at $1.79B, Dec 2025 at $1.82B, Aug 2026 at $1.04B. [LotteryUSA](https://www.lotteryusa.com/news/will-powerball-deliver-first-billion-dollar-jackpot-2026)
- **Odds:** the jackpot odds are 1 in 292.2M per ticket. The chance someone wins a given drawing rises with ticket sales, which rise with the jackpot.

## 5. Other forecasts
- None of the collected prediction markets (Kalshi, Polymarket) relate to Powerball; they cover OpenAI, Venezuela and so on. I found no Kalshi, Polymarket or Manifold market or expert forecast on the Powerball jackpot at year-end 2026.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The Oct 26 result is still unconfirmed. Next drawing: Wed Oct 28, $716M if Oct 26 had no winner.
- Draws are every Mon, Wed and Sat at 10:59 pm ET through Dec 30, with Sat Jan 2, 2027 next. Christmas (Fri) and New Year's Day (Fri) do not fall on draw days.
- Any jackpot win resets the jackpot to $20M. The value at resolution depends mainly on when the last win before Dec 30 happens. A win in late December would leave $20-50M. A win in early to mid November would leave roughly $150-400M, based on the reset paths above.
- Press often covers holiday-season sales surges when the jackpot is large; this happened in Dec 2025.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) Time left: about 9 weeks. The question resolves around Dec 31, 2026 00:00 UTC. That makes the relevant figure most likely the advertised jackpot for Wed Dec 30. About 28-29 drawings remain, starting with Oct 26.

(b) Latest known value: $687M estimated for the Mon Oct 26, 2026 drawing (Powerball.com and Texas Lottery). It rises to $716M for Oct 28 if no one won Oct 26.

(c) If nothing changed: $687M. This is not a realistic outcome, because the jackpot either grows or resets to $20M every drawing.

(d) If the current trend continued with no winner through Dec 30, the jackpot would be roughly $2B or more. That is very unlikely. Ticket sales grow sharply above $1B, so the chance of a win per drawing reaches 20-45%. Under my own rough model (my simulation produced no output, so these figures are hand calculations), the current run is won by around Nov 7-11 at the median and almost surely by late November. After that, the jackpot resets to $20M.

(e) Historical variation: the outcome mainly depends on how many drawings have passed since the last reset.
- Past reset paths: about $100-120M after 6-8 drawings, about $200M after 11-17, about $300M after about 16, about $410M after about 20, and about $500M+ after 24 or more.
- At low jackpots, roughly 3-5% of drawings produce a winner. So a second reset before Dec 30 is quite likely, maybe 50-60%.
- My rough calculation of the chance the Dec 30 jackpot is at least a given level:
  - $110M or more: about 80%
  - $200M or more: about 65%
  - $300M or more: about 50%
  - $400M or more: about 25%
  - $500M or more: about 10%

(f) Experts and markets: none found. No prediction market covers this question.

(g) Unexpected scenarios:
- **Low:** someone wins the jackpot in a late-December drawing, so the Dec 30 jackpot is $20-50M.
- **High:** the current run survives an unusually long dry streak through Dec 30, giving $1.5-2.5B+. My estimate for this is about 1-2%. A more moderate high case: a win in late October followed by no further winner gives about $550-650M by Dec 30.
